name: v32-video-tune
title: v3.2 video tune: independent brightness/contrast/saturate/warmth/grayscale adjustments
description: Independent video picture adjustment engine: per-video CSS-filter tune (brightness reduction, contrast, saturation, warmth, grayscale) applied to all videos regardless of inversion state, composed with the inversion chain on the active video, quick preset chips (eye-comfort/night/vivid/reset), modal section with reusable sliders, persistence and bench coverage.
